statusGroups.reason: [Pinned declaration](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/doc/classes/@GlobalScope.xml#L2993-L3094). ADRs 0005/0023; see [role audit](../property-usage.md). Bit 2 selects scene serialization. IsStored=true on writable typed descriptors drives capture and ordinary setter restoration. PropertyUsage.Consumer checks memory/file round trips and transient exclusion; storage does not imply editor visibility.

[Pinned declaration](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/doc/classes/@GlobalScope.xml#L2993-L3094). ADRs 0005/0023; see [role audit](../property-usage.md). Value 0 combines no storage with no Inspector display. stored=false retains discovery/read/write and skips storage. Trigger: independent typed Inspector visibility metadata and consuming inspector under ADR 0005.

[Pinned declaration](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/doc/classes/@GlobalScope.xml#L2993-L3094). ADRs 0005/0023; see [role audit](../property-usage.md). Value 2 aliases STORAGE without the EDITOR bit. IsStored=true covers storage only and does not hide discovery or Inspector display. Trigger: independent typed Inspector visibility metadata and consuming inspector under ADR 0005.

[Pinned declaration](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/doc/classes/@GlobalScope.xml#L2993-L3094). ADRs 0005/0023; see [role audit](../property-usage.md). Bit 268435456 restricts Inspector editing, not programmatic setters or restoration. IsReadOnly means no programmatic setter and is not equivalent. Trigger: independent editor-only editability metadata and consuming inspector preserving typed writes under ADR 0005.
